description: Hardware detection completes within 5 seconds on any supported machine
property: For any supported hardware configuration, detect_hardware() SHALL populate all required fields in HardwareProfile within 5 seconds

invariants.description: Total detection time must not exceed 5000ms
Each individual detector must timeout after 2000ms
All required fields in HardwareProfile must be non-null after detection
invariants.assertion: profile.cpu != null && profile.memory != null && profile.storage != null && profile.network != null && profile.hardware_class != null
